subject: Vendor enrollment & invoice routing — Thornbridge (PO / VAT / Escrow)
messages:
From: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@thornbridge.co.uk>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: AP Portal <ap-portal@thornbridge.co.uk>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to register Redwood as an approved supplier in our AP system so we can begin issuing POs and start the first month of usage. To speed this up our team asked for the following from your side: 

- Completed AP supplier form (attached)
- Remit details (bank name, IBAN, SWIFT) and invoice remit-to email
- VAT registration certificate or confirmation of reverse-charge applicability
- Preferred PO acknowledgement behaviour (PO number required on invoice / PO line-level matching)
- Any early-payment / escrow routing constraints (we have a new customer escrow pilot that requires a separate remit address)

We'd like to get Redwood live in our portal by June 7th to align with our purchasing cadence. Can you confirm who will be your primary contact for the portal (name, email), and whether your invoices will be sent via e-invoice (Peppol) or by email?

Attached: Thornbridge_AP_Form_20260530.pdf, Thornbridge_VAT_Template.pdf

Regards,
Marta Kovac
Head of Supplier Operations
Thornbridge Ltd
--
Note: 
AP Portal support contact: ap-portal@thornbridge.co.uk
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@thornbridge.co.uk>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Hi Marta — thanks, this is clear. Quick answers inline: 

- AP form: received and reviewed; we'll return a completed copy with bank details attached (Thornbridge form ticked).
- Remit details: Redwood Ltd (EU operations) will remit to our UK bank for Thornbridge billing: NatWest / Account name: Redwood Inference Ltd / IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819 / SWIFT: NWBKGB2L. Invoices should be emailed to invoices@redwood.com (or sent via Peppol; see below).
- VAT: We operate with no UK VAT on B2B services where a valid UK EU VAT ID is provided and reverse-charge applies. We'll attach a copy of our VAT registration and a short attestation.
- PO handling: Prefer invoice-level PO number matching (PO number on header) rather than line-level. We can support line-level if you require it but it adds processing time; please confirm which you prefer.
- Escrow / early payment: We're able to support an alternate remit email for escrow routing (escrow-invoices@redwood.com). If you use an escrow connector that requires separate account metadata, let us know the field names and we will provision.

Primary portal contact: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> (AP coordinator)
Alternate finance: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Technical for e-invoice: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Attachments: Redwood_Bank_Details_20260601.pdf, Redwood_VAT_Attestation_20260601.pdf

Next steps: If you confirm whether you want PO header vs line-level matching and whether escrow needs a separate account record, we'll return the completed form and push to your portal today.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Partnerships (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com; grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:17:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: Vendor registration request — Thornbridge (VAT check + escrow)

Jonas / Grace — forwarding Thornbridge's ask. A couple of internal clarifications before we send the finished packet: 

1) VAT evidence: Grace, please attach the scanned VAT cert (we have Redwood_VATCert_2026.pdf in the secure drive). Finance prefers a government-issued certificate; our attestation should only be used as fallback.

2) Escrow pilot: Legal flagged that if Thornbridge's escrow connector requires a separate bank account, we must not expose primary account credentials. Suggest we offer a 'pay-to' escrow email address + unique remittance reference, and route settlement to our controlled escrow clearing account. Does Ops have a simple switch?

3) PO matching: Our AP prefers header-level PO matching for SaaS usage invoices. If Thornbridge insists on line-level matching we should state expected delay.

I'll draft the final response for Jonas to send.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@thornbridge.co.uk>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Portal <ap-portal@thornbridge.co.uk>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas — thanks, that all looks good. Quick confirmations from our side:

- We'll accept PO header matching.
- Our escrow connector can use a separate remit-to email and a remit reference; no need to store a separate bank account in our portal. Please send escrow-invoices@redwood.com as the remit-to and include the field ESCROW_REF in the portal metadata (we'll map that to the connector).
- We accept PDF VAT certs for now; we'll request the government cert if we need it for audit.
- We'll provision Redwood in our portal today and will send you a test PO (THOR-PO-7431) by end of day; please confirm when you receive it so we can start the first invoices on Monday.

Attachments: Thornbridge_AP_Form_20260530.pdf (completed), Portal_Add_Record_Link: https://portal.thornbridge.co.uk/suppliers/new/THOR-4592

Best,
Marta
